about: Hand-written reference replies, NOT model output. CI checks them on every push, so the eval runner and the rules stay tested. To test the real model, set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and run ./gradlew :evals:run --args=live; add --record to replace these with recorded replies.

replies.flow-cold: [{"front": "Is a Flow hot or cold?", "back": "Cold"}, {"front": "What starts a cold Flow?", "back": "A terminal operator such as collect"}]
replies.stateflow: [{"front": "What does a StateFlow always hold?", "back": "A current value"}, {"front": "What does a new StateFlow collector get first?", "back": "The current value"}]
replies.sharedflow: [{"front": "Who receives a SharedFlow's values?", "back": "Every active collector"}, {"front": "Can a SharedFlow replay past values?", "back": "Yes, a configurable number of them"}]
replies.channel: [{"front": "How many receivers get each value sent to a Channel?", "back": "Exactly one receiver"}]
replies.suspend: [{"front": "Does a suspend function block its thread while paused?", "back": "No; it pauses without blocking the thread"}]
replies.dispatchers: [{"front": "Which dispatcher suits blocking input and output?", "back": "Dispatchers.IO"}, {"front": "Which dispatcher suits CPU-heavy work?", "back": "Dispatchers.Default"}]
replies.viewmodelscope: [{"front": "When is viewModelScope cancelled?", "back": "When the ViewModel is cleared"}]
replies.room-entity: [{"front": "What does @Entity do in Room?", "back": "Marks a class as a table"}, {"front": "What does @PrimaryKey mark?", "back": "The column that identifies each row"}]
replies.room-dao: [{"front": "What does a Room DAO declare?", "back": "The database queries"}, {"front": "When does Room generate the DAO's code?", "back": "At build time"}]
replies.room-migration: [{"front": "What does a Room migration do?", "back": "Moves data to a new schema version without losing it"}]
replies.hilt-inject: [{"front": "What does @Inject on a constructor tell Hilt?", "back": "How to create the class"}]
replies.hilt-provides: [{"front": "When do you need a @Module with @Provides?", "back": "To supply types you don't own, like Retrofit"}]
replies.remember: [{"front": "What does remember keep a value across?", "back": "Recompositions"}, {"front": "Which keeps a value across rotation too?", "back": "rememberSaveable"}]
replies.recomposition: [{"front": "Which composables does Compose redraw?", "back": "Only those that read the state that changed"}]
replies.lazycolumn: [{"front": "Which items does LazyColumn compose?", "back": "Only those on screen"}, {"front": "Why give LazyColumn items stable keys?", "back": "So their state follows them"}]
replies.navigation3: [{"front": "What is the back stack in Navigation 3?", "back": "A list of keys that your code owns and changes"}]
replies.datastore: [{"front": "What is Preferences DataStore for?", "back": "Small key-value settings, stored asynchronously"}]
replies.workmanager: [{"front": "What kind of work is WorkManager for?", "back": "Deferrable work that must survive an app restart"}]
replies.val-var: [{"front": "Can a val be reassigned?", "back": "No"}, {"front": "Can a var be reassigned?", "back": "Yes"}]
replies.elvis: [{"front": "What does the Elvis operator ?: do?", "back": "Gives a default when the left side is null"}]
replies.data-class: [{"front": "Which functions does a data class get?", "back": "equals, hashCode, toString and copy"}]
replies.sealed: [{"front": "Why does a sealed interface help a when expression?", "back": "It can be exhaustive without an else branch"}]
replies.extension: [{"front": "What does an extension function add to a type?", "back": "A function, without changing the type's source"}]
replies.r8: [{"front": "What does R8 do to release builds?", "back": "Shrinks and obfuscates them"}, {"front": "What protects code used by reflection from R8?", "back": "Keep rules"}]
replies.baseline-profile: [{"front": "What does a Baseline Profile precompile?", "back": "The code used at startup"}, {"front": "What gets faster with a Baseline Profile?", "back": "The first launch"}]
replies.inject-link: [{"front": "When does Hilt generate its components?", "back": "At compile time"}]
